title: physostegia purpurea
intro: Physostegia purpurea, commonly known as Obedience Plant or Snakeroot, is a perennial herb native to North America. It is used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Physostegia purpurea include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in relieving congestion and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, particularly physostigmine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
